messages.text:
"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy RPG project called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS:
Create a beautiful true 3D fantasy game with a fixed isometric camera angled diagonally from above. The camera follows the player without rotating or changing distance. Optimize the graphics for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION:
Before entering the game, create a character selection screen with:

- Male or female character.
- Custom character name.
- Faction selection: Angels or Demons.
- Three classes: Warrior, Mage and Assassin.
- Different hairstyles, hair colors and eye colors.
- Three starting outfits.
- Interactive 3D character preview.

Angels have celestial wings. Demons have demonic wings.

FIRST GAME AREA:
Create one detailed starting village with houses, trees, paths and interactive NPCs. Add a surrounding area with three different monsters.

GAMEPLAY:
Implement mobile joystick movement, normal attacks, one special skill per class, HP and MP bars, monster health bars, experience points and leveling.

TECHNICAL:
Use a real 3D rendering engine supported by the environment. Build a playable mobile browser prototype, not a mockup. Keep the code modular and test character creation, 3D graphics, camera, movement and combat. Fix errors before finishing.

This is the foundation of the larger AETHERIA MMORPG. Keep the architecture expandable for future crafting, equipment, fusion, quests, dungeons, trading and multiplayer. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
